facts.en: Earned a Bachelor of Engineering in electrical engineering at Fictional Sunreed Institute in 2016-06.
facts.zh: 2016-06 在虚构日苇学院获得电气工程工学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a paid maintenance-records coordinator at Fictional Coppermeadow Facilities from 2016-09 to 2018-12.
facts.zh: 2016-09 至 2018-12 在虚构铜甸设施公司任有薪维护记录协调员。

facts.en: In that role, reconciled equipment identifiers between work orders and a maintenance register and requested clarification from technicians.
facts.zh: 在该岗位核对工单与维护登记册中的设备编号，并向技术人员请求澄清。

facts.en: Was a paid renewable-energy data analyst at Fictional Clearwatt Monitoring from 2019-01 to 2022-07.
facts.zh: 2019-01 至 2022-07 在虚构澄瓦监测公司任有薪可再生能源数据分析员。

facts.en: Served as a paid solar performance analyst at Fictional Asterbeam Services from 2022-08 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2022-08 至 2026-09 在虚构星束服务公司任有薪光伏性能分析员。

facts.en: Reviewed inverter output, meter energy and irradiance sensor feeds for 9 assigned sites within the team's 24-site portfolio.
facts.zh: 审核团队 24 个站点组合中分配给个人的 9 个站点的逆变器输出、电表电量及辐照度传感器数据。

facts.en: Uses Python with pandas to resample time series, SQL to join device registers and Git to track analysis-script revisions.
facts.zh: 使用 Python 的 pandas 重采样时间序列，使用 SQL 关联设备登记册，并使用 Git 跟踪分析脚本版本。

facts.en: Checked site time zones, daylight-saving transitions, meter reset markers and units before comparing daily totals.
facts.zh: 比较每日总量前，检查站点时区、夏令时切换、电表重置标记及单位。

facts.en: Marked communications gaps separately from zero-output intervals and kept the original raw files alongside the processed tables.
facts.zh: 将通信中断与零输出时段分开标记，并在处理后表格之外保留原始文件。

facts.en: For a 2025-07 to 2025-09 review, personally wrote the data-quality checks and exception table; a colleague maintained the dashboard and a field engineer investigated site conditions.
facts.zh: 在 2025-07 至 2025-09 审核中，个人编写数据质量检查与异常表；同事维护仪表板，现场工程师调查站点状况。

facts.en: The review used five-minute data from 6 of the assigned sites and retained a file-level record of excluded intervals.
facts.zh: 该审核使用所负责站点中 6 个站点的五分钟间隔数据，并保留文件级排除时段记录。

facts.en: The exception table flagged 36 site-time windows for investigation; these were not 36 confirmed equipment failures.
facts.zh: 异常表标记 36 个站点时间窗供调查；这些并非 36 起已确认的设备故障。

facts.en: A handoff worksheet listed 418 monitored site-days for the review, but did not state whether days with partial communications gaps were included.
facts.zh: 交接工作表列出该审核涵盖 418 个监测站点日，但未说明是否包含存在部分通信中断的日期。

facts.en: Sent engineers a weekly evidence packet containing plots, device IDs, data-coverage notes and open questions.
facts.zh: 每周向工程师发送依据材料包，内含图表、设备编号、数据覆盖说明及未解决问题。

facts.en: Engineers confirmed physical faults and operations managers approved maintenance visits; the candidate prioritized data exceptions for their review.
facts.zh: 工程师确认物理故障，运营经理批准维护访问；候选人将数据异常排序供其审核。

facts.en: A separate 2026-02 desktop exercise estimated 68.4 MWh of potential recovery across 3 selected sites using a colleague's baseline workbook.
facts.zh: 另一项 2026-02 桌面分析使用同事的基准工作簿，估算 3 个选定站点的潜在可恢复电量为 68.4 MWh。

facts.en: The exercise notes say the baseline was adjusted, but the retained copy does not specify whether the adjustment included weather normalization.
facts.zh: 该分析笔记称基准已经调整，但保留副本未说明调整是否包括气象归一化。

facts.en: The 68.4 MWh figure was a modeled opportunity before field work; no post-maintenance recovered-energy measurement was attached.
facts.zh: 68.4 MWh 是现场工作开展前通过模型估算的潜在可恢复电量；未附维护后的恢复电量实测值。

facts.en: Maintains small test datasets for midnight boundaries, duplicate timestamps and negative cumulative-meter differences.
facts.zh: 维护小型测试数据集，覆盖午夜边界、重复时间戳及累计电表读数出现负差值的情况。

facts.en: Explained data-coverage caveats in English and Mandarin during monthly analyst-operations calls.
facts.zh: 在每月分析员与运营人员会议中，用英语和普通话解释数据覆盖范围的限制。

facts.en: Completed an internal photovoltaic-system overview course in 2020-11; holds no electrical installation or commissioning credential.
facts.zh: 2020-11 完成内部光伏系统概览课程；未持有电气安装或调试资格。

facts.en: Built a personal indoor-temperature logger in 2024 and plotted gaps caused by battery changes.
facts.zh: 2024 年制作个人室内温度记录器，并绘图展示更换电池导致的数据间断。

facts.en: Enjoys repairing analog synthesizer knobs and keeping a handwritten listening journal.
facts.zh: 爱好修理模拟合成器旋钮，并手写聆听日记。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Lanternpond Community Hall during 2023, preparing the rota for a weekly board-game room.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构灯塘社区会堂做志愿者，为每周桌游活动室编排值班表。
